snippet.title: Strait of Hormuz Minic Arcade Game Trailer #steam #retrogaming #arcade #missile #casualgaming
snippet.description:
The Strait of Hormuz Mini Arcade is a retro-style 2D shooter where world economy is at risk! Shoot down attacking speedboats and missile launchers to protect vital shipping lanes. Forget high scores—your real objective is keeping global oil prices low to prevent total recession! Or switch sides...
Game on Steam for Windows: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5010210/Strait_of_Hormuz_Mini_Arcade/
